claim_candidate.statement: CXL link capabilities and observed pooled-system behavior are different evaluation layers. A standard's link rate and RAS features do not predict workload latency, transfer-direction behavior, contention, or balance across pooled devices.
claim_candidate.temporal_scope: CXL 4.0 announcement in 2025 and an ICS study in 2026
conditions: The reported 214 ns and 658 ns measurements belong to one published setup and are not universal constants.
